name: VeriScore
why_it_matters: Newsrooms need to know whether AI outputs can be traced back to verifiable, authoritative evidence rather than plausible-sounding fabrications.
task_shape: Given long-form model outputs, extract verifiable claims and check each against retrieved web evidence, scoring both precision (share of claims supported) and recall of verifiable facts.
signals: Focuses on verifiable claims only, avoiding penalizing subjective or unverifiable statements and producing a reproducible pipeline.
Relies on general web search for evidence rather than curated authoritative databases, so verdicts can inherit source-quality problems.
